_comment: Cross-implementation leaf vector. The identical file lives at
The contract exports leaf() so an off-chain builder can be tested against
it rather than against a second implementation of the same rules that can
drift. That check was never wired up and the two did drift: for these
inputs the contract produces contract_leaf_contributor below, and the Go
builder in merkle.go produces backend_leaf_current. They hash different
field sets, so no choice of inputs makes them agree.
Both digests are recorded here on purpose. Once a canonical construction is
chosen and both sides implement it, this collapses to one `leaf_contributor`
value asserted from Go and from Rust, and the two `*_current` fields go.

constructions.backend: sha256(0x00 || identity_hash || address_utf8 || amount_i64_be8 || chain_id_utf8 || event_id_utf8)
